workflow_runs.display_title: fix: exclude base64 image data URLs from context token estimation

head_commit.message:
fix: exclude base64 image data URLs from context token estimation

Image data URLs (data:image/...;base64,...) in InputImage content items
were being counted at their full serialized length (~4 bytes per token),
causing massive overcounting. A 100KB base64 payload would estimate as
~25K tokens when the model actually processes it as a fixed-cost image.

This change:
- Adds estimate_image_data_url_bytes() to detect and measure data URL
  content inside ContentItem::InputImage and FunctionCallOutputContentItem
- Subtracts the base64 payload size and adds a fixed IMAGE_BYTES_ESTIMATE
  (340 bytes ≈ 85 tokens) matching typical vision model tile costs
- Applies the adjustment in estimate_response_item_model_visible_bytes()

Without this fix, conversations with MCP tool screenshots would hit the
context limit far too early, triggering aggressive truncation.

Fixes #11845
